title: Rollout management API & SDK helpers: canaries, A/B splits, shadow traffic, and auto-rollback
creator: Aisha Fernandez
description:
Define and deliver a set of first-class API endpoints and SDK client helpers for managing model rollouts across Redwood deployments. Scope: create/update/list rollouts, adjust traffic splits for canary and A/B experiments, enable/disable shadow traffic, triggers for automatic rollback, idempotent client helpers, and explicit permission scopes. The outcome should let platform and product engineers automate safe progressive rollouts and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines and the Redwood Console.

Goals:
- Standardize rollout resource schema and lifecycle operations across Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
- Provide SDK helpers (Python/TS/Go) for idempotent create/apply operations and polling for status.
- Ensure auditability and fine-grained RBAC for creation, modification, and forced rollbacks.
- Expose telemetry hooks and webhooks for rollout events and automatic rollback decisions.

Non-goals:
- Model selection UI (Console work tracked separately).
- Advanced experiment analysis (metrics collection will rely on existing observability pipelines).
acceptance_criteria: API: POST /v1/rollouts creates a rollout with immutable id and returns operation token
API: PATCH /v1/rollouts/{id}/traffic accepts absolute percentages and validates sum==100
API: POST /v1/rollouts/{id}/shadow toggles shadowing per-route/model and returns confirmation
Permissions: rollout.create|update|view|rollback scopes enforced and audited
Auto-rollback: server-side policy supports abort on error-rate spike, latency regression, or custom metric thresholds
E2E: sample CI pipeline shows canary -> automated metrics check -> full rollout or rollback

Implement backend endpoints and idempotency token support (ENG)

2026-03-12 - Liam O'Connor: Implementation plan approved by ENG leads. PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4287 (backend) and SDK PRs will follow. Security review kickoff scheduled for 2026-03-16.
notes: Idempotency rules: Client provides X-Idempotency-Key on create. Server persists mapping to rollout id for 24h. create_or_get helper should poll with exponential backoff and honor 409 states as idempotent conflict resolution.

Auto-rollback flow: On trigger, rollout state -> ROLLING_BACK, traffic rebalanced to baseline, webhook emitted to configured endpoints, and rollback reason stored in audit trail. Admins can opt for manual override after postmortem.
